prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Finish new screen changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests, with 1 test stopped early due to worse adoption.
Adoption new screen changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Sign-in redesign changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Choose path redesign changes can be helpful (1 test won), though 3 tests showed no clear effect; evidence is still thin for single-test categories (finish new flow, finish redesign, home redesign, sign-in hint, and sign-in reorder).
Positive predictions were generally too high (with a few exceptions), while negative predictions were too low as all tests predicting negative results measured positive outcomes after noise correction.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -2.4% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +1.9% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: -2.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: +1.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, redesign: -0.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -3.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 87.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Split Narrative Layout: Reframe the story screen using a split layout that presents the pet backstory alongside path option highlights. (why: Choose path has an 87.2% conversion rate and high mean time (514s), showing users need clearer initial context.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Account Restoration Clarification: Display a hint on sign-in clarifying that signing into an existing account restores previous pets and data. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or resetting after users signed in again.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Two Column Selection Redesign: Redesign the friend selection screen into a two column layout comparing pet personalities side by side. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9% and takes a median of 89s / mean 1017s.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Status Readiness Tip: Add desktop preparation tips and an optional completion notification switch to the waiting screen. (why: The home stage wait averages 201s median / 2336s mean, leading to drop-offs and support questions.)
4: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Placement Guidance Screen: Insert a new screen before home completion providing clear instructions on where the mascot appears on desktop. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets not showing on desktop and 3 emails confused about controls after setup.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Choose Path Explicit Mode Descriptions: Update headline and body copy on choose path screen to explicitly contrast quick companion vs custom pet modes. (why: Choose path mean duration of 514s indicates confusion between available paths.)
6: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Card Welcome Redesign: Redesign home intro into a card layout displaying quick control shortcuts (hide, summon, speak). (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to hide, control, or talk to the pet.)
7: [choose_path, new_screen] Story Mode Selection Overview Screen: Add a dedicated mode overview screen right after story introducing path capabilities. (why: Adding context early helps address path selection hesitation and improves funnel flow into sign-in.)

scores.note: Choose path drops only 12.8%; redesigns here showed moderate success (+1.9% average across 4 tests).
Sign-in loses 27.1% and 8 support emails confirm user confusion. Config-only hint is cheap but lift is historically low (+0.1%).
Adoption loses 39.1%, but adoption redesigns consistently failed (-2.4% average, 1 test stopped early).
Home step wait time is long (2336s mean) with support questions; minor UI additions on home showed mild promise (+1.6%).
Finish loses 35.2% and 6 support emails support this, but adding new screens has proven ineffective (+0.4% across 3 tests) and costs a release.
Copy tweak on choose path is config-only (low cost), but targeted step drop-off is relatively small (12.8%).
Finish drops 35.2% and 3 support emails confirm post-onboarding confusion; however, finish redesigns historically measured -1.0%.
Adding new screens shows no clear positive effect across multiple categories, and requires a full release.
